events.method: Unchanged D0.4.1 univariate fit on first 30 published sessions; fixed thereafter

factor_pnl_note: Additive cumulative returns over aligned decomposition rows, unit notional; raw = explained + residual. Not compound equity or executable cash P&L.

landscape.cost_model: Prior-session half-spread plus liquidity-stress proxy, no measured fills/impact/fees
landscape.evaluation: Rolling in-sample descriptive policy replay; no walk-forward profit claim
landscape.policy: Three disclosed heuristic agents; softmax temperature; lagged stress attenuation. NOT deployed MacroHFT agents.
landscape.return_unit: Decimal simple returns; annualized arithmetic mean, not CAGR

limitations: Experimental composites and thresholds are descriptive heuristics, not calibrated probability or profitability.
No automatic provider download: explicit publication/vintage timestamps are mandatory.
Hawkes boundary/criticality limitations remain; no graph or precise edge intervals enter state.
Factor loadings and landscape optima are historical estimates; no out-of-sample validation.
Missing components remain null; a partial fracture is not promoted to a complete score.

momentum_regimes.note: One-session lagged signal; descriptive gross subset path, no OOS claim. Turnover uses chronological positions including regime switches. Sample support is not a probability.

seasonality.baseline_rule: Same weekday/bucket; only prior sessions known by that cell's current publication; min 5 observations; robust z requires 10
seasonality.event_unit: Aggregate events per minute; NOT necessarily trades
seasonality.vol_unit: Session-equivalent close-to-close bucket magnitude; first bucket unavailable

world.calendar_note: Synthetic weekdays only; NOT an exchange holiday calendar
world.source: Seed 642011 illustrative volatility/factor/event world; no market data
